scope: Pre-Mesa registered parliamentary submissions, including pending, inadmitted and failed; not publication-only cases

sources.documented_system: webGTP Registre d'entrada / Expedients; SERES registry software version history
sources.observation_level: Official manual text via public index; public documentation/versions, not raw database
sources.coverage_limitation: WebGTP manual explicitly filters to entries having or having had parliamentary processing; not every raw submission is shown, and some attachments are access restricted or time-gated
sources.documented_pagination: Manual shows an internal selected-document count and numbered pages for a filtered view; no open bulk export with certified total
sources.event_sequence_source: Expedient screen displays historical steps but is a public interface, not a licensed all-events export
sources.historical_versions: SERES software release notes dated 2026, not record-level snapshots
sources.privacy_or_access: Original entry documents can be restricted until a deadline; SERES exports follow user permissions and can contain names/emails/phones/addresses
sources.best_reopen_gate: Specific public dataset licence for entry-book nonpersonal metadata, including zero-processing submissions and stable register IDs, plus independent signed register total and archived snapshots

sources.parliament: Junta General del Principado de Asturias
sources.documented_system: WSAgora.xml open data for chamber composition, RSS of bulletins and diary, XML of votes; Actualidad: daily registered initiatives
sources.observation_level: Official open-data catalogue and example dated news post via public reader
sources.coverage_limitation: The open XML sources explicitly document deputies/organs, publications and votes, not the original input-register entries; daily news is not an official publication and time-limited submissions are deliberately held until the deadline
sources.documented_pagination: Archive of news posts, no independently counted exhaustive all-received pagination
sources.event_sequence_source: Separate current procedural search, not mapped to open data entry ledger
sources.historical_versions: Daily posted news dates are dissemination dates of a selected set, not attested per-row as-of history
sources.privacy_or_access: Public posts can contain names and subjects; date-delayed publication is explicitly documented
sources.best_reopen_gate: Official signed daily entry-book counts and dated full metadata lists inclusive of not-yet-admitted filings, with licence and versioned archive

sources.documented_system: 2001 BOPCA 730 tender specification for parliamentary information system linking general register, case files, acts and publications
sources.observation_level: Primary historical procurement specification text; not proof that the requested software was built or currently operational
sources.coverage_limitation: Planned general register includes both parliamentary and administrative documents; full entry book is not demonstrably available to public in CSV/XML and neither the link nor its current implementation is attested
sources.event_sequence_source: Specified separate record-to-expedient association, workflow events, and publication modules; planned functionality only
sources.historical_versions: No historically versioned exported row-level corpus; dated 2001 specification only
sources.privacy_or_access: Internal roles and permissions mentioned in specification; administrative documents mixed with parliament-origin items
sources.best_reopen_gate: Find publisher documentation of actually deployed registry export, public licensed subset of parliamentary entry type and total count per temporal slice

sources.documented_system: Parliamentary procedures and Mesa qualification/admission under Regulation article 49 and 2015 revision article 50; Senate library points to regional parliamentary database
sources.observation_level: Official published rules and official Senate source directory; no raw file of the Assembly
sources.coverage_limitation: Regulation describes presentation followed by qualification and admission, but no documented all-received dataset, source-specific licence, independent count or cursor
sources.event_sequence_source: Rules set procedural stages, not exported dated events
sources.historical_versions: 2008 and 2015 regulatory revisions are law versions, not historical records
sources.privacy_or_access: No licensed privacy-minimized bulk source verified
sources.best_reopen_gate: Publisher-specific metadata export of Registry entries before Mesa and official all-received counts; distinguish from regional executive open data

sources.documented_system: Separate data-processing records for Entrada/Salida and Initiatives/Expedientes; SERES electronic submission services, Mesa qualified admissions
sources.observation_level: Official privacy inventory, public filing-service index and procedural regulation; Generalitat/executive search is control-to-government subset
sources.coverage_limitation: Filing service is a workflow for submission, not an open entry-book download; executive transparency pages filter to interpellations/questions/motions directed to regional government
sources.event_sequence_source: Procedural reference exists but public all-events feed not documented
sources.historical_versions: Data-processing register amendments 2019/2020/2023/2024 are not versions of parliamentary entries
sources.privacy_or_access: Identity numbers, addresses, contact information and political affiliation may be present in raw parliamentary-initiatives register
sources.best_reopen_gate: A legal, publicly distributed, privacy-minimized identifier/date-only entry log with record counts and licence, separate from personal-data-bearing dossiers

sources.documented_system: Parliamentary initiative listings with entry-register number, entry date and subsequent procedural acts
sources.observation_level: Official public HTML index and official intellectual-property and usage notice
sources.coverage_limitation: Index covers parliamentary cases, not entire all-received registry; no official independent total, no public versioned event CSV/XML
sources.covers_pending_verified: some cases displayed as in process; full pending universe not verified
sources.documented_pagination: No proven complete all-received page traversal with independent total
sources.event_sequence_source: HTML linked acts with entry register numbers and bulletin references, but no licensed bulk download
sources.historical_versions: Current web may be updated/removed; archived per-record as-of snapshots unverified
sources.privacy_or_access: Aviso legal III: access implies accepting conditions; V: private noncommercial download only, copy/distribution requires prior written permission
sources.best_reopen_gate: Distribution expressly licensed for reuse without contractual acceptance; archive with total independent of published-case index; otherwise do not fetch

quality_note: Publicly indexed and read-through results have no independent original-file SHA or HTTP Date from a direct GET in ronda8; do not mistake search previews, PDF text or rules for downloaded raw source.
